content.content: My friend and I are planning a 2-day trip to London, followed by 3 days in Paris.             Can you recommend the top-rated car rental companies and restaurants in both cities?             We're also looking for the best-rated hotels in London and Paris. If there are multiple             options, we prefer the most expensive ones. All prices should be in euros. Please provide             the names of the two car rental companies and restaurants, restaurants, as well as the             total maximum expense for the 5-day trip (assuming 2 meals per day). Thank you!

```python
# Get the names of top-rated car rental companies in London and Paris
car_rental_companies = query_ai_assistant(
    "What are the names of the top-rated car rental companies in London and Paris?",
    list[str]
)

# Get the names of top-rated restaurants in London and Paris
restaurants = query_ai_assistant(
    "What are the names of the top-rated restaurants in London and Paris?",
    list[str]
)

# Get the names of top-rated hotels in London and Paris
hotels = query_ai_assistant(
    "What are the names of the top-rated hotels in London and Paris?",
    list[str]
)

# Get the prices of the car rental companies
car_rental_prices = get_car_price_per_day(car_rental_companies)

# Get the prices of the restaurants
restaurant_prices = get_price_for_restaurants(restaurants)

# Get the prices of the hotels
hotel_prices = get_hotels_prices(hotels)

# Calculate the total maximum expense for the 5-day trip
total_max_expense = sum(car_rental_prices.values()) + sum(restaurant_prices.values()) * 2 * 5 + sum(hotel_prices.values()) * 5

print("Car Rental Companies:", car_rental_companies)
print("Restaurants:", restaurants)
print("Hotels:", hotels)
print("Total Maximum Expense for the 5-day trip:", total_max_expense, "euros")
```
